messages.text: What are the most important signal integrity capabilities for applications in Wireless Communication?

The passages do not rank the “most important” capabilities, but they do support these key Signal Integrity–related capabilities for Wireless Communication applications: interface testing with scopes, BERTs, AWGs and switch matrices; RefClk / PLL jitter performance testing with phase noise analyzers and signal generators; PDN testing with scopes and network analyzers; ADC / DAC frontend performance testing with spectrum analyzers and signal generators; and PCB/PCBA SI flow items including insertion loss, crosstalk, eye diagram, TDR impedance, stackup planning and transmission-line calculation [1][2].  
For wireless device and certification contexts, relevant capabilities also include RF testing, EMC, spectrum, output power, DFS, SAR, EMI / EMS, ESD, power surge, protocol compatibility, interoperability, PTCRB / GCF certification, TRP, TIS and EVM measurement [7][11][70].  
For mmWave / 5G FR2 wireless applications, supported capabilities include CATR chamber measurement, 3–40 GHz main transmit band support, unwanted-emission measurement to 90 GHz, TRP / TIS / EVM measurement, FR2 radiated test setups, and short-cable remote-radio-head architectures to optimize radiated chamber link budget [7][23][38].  
For OTA and MIMO wireless performance, supported capabilities include antenna and radio performance validation in realistic indoor / urban multipath RF environments, Wi‑Fi 7 / IEEE 802.11be MIMO stress testing under realistic conditions, SISO / MIMO OTA support, carrier aggregation across many channels and bands, and Wi‑Fi / Bluetooth / Narrowband NTN / RedCap support in integrated OTA solutions [34][35][41][42][44].  
For signal and spectrum analysis, supported capabilities include phase noise, modulation quality / EVM, cross-correlation, extended SFDR, improved DANL for hidden spurs, distortion and noise measurement in the presence of high-power carriers, phase-coherent multiport receiver analysis, simultaneous signal and spectrum analysis, antenna H/V polarization comparison, and direct comparison of amplitude, frequency and phase between ports [13].

無線通訊認證實驗室 › 重點摘要
本來源是由 `無線通訊認證實驗室.pptx` 轉出的 company restricted 簡報，正式發布日期與文件版次未標示；raw frontmatter 顯示 converted 日期為 2026-09-17。

來源將[[無線通訊認證實驗室]]定義為測試與驗證無線設備符合法規、安全與性能標準的實驗室，涵蓋 [[RF 測試]]、[[EMC]]、安規與一致性認證，並稱其可支援 [[Global Market Access]]（GMA）與加速上市。

主要內容包括：

- 無線設備認證實驗室涵蓋 RF、EMC、安規與一致性認證。
- 主要測試項目包含頻譜、輸出功率、[[DFS]]、[[SAR]]、EMI / EMS、靜電放電、電源突波、[[Protocol 相容性]]、互操作性測試與 [[PTCRB]] / [[GCF]] 認證。
- 來源稱認證必要性包括防止電磁干擾與頻譜衝突、保障用戶安全、加速上市、降低召回與法律風險，以及滿足台灣供應鏈衛星終端與 6G 等需求。
- 來源列出台灣 [[NCC]] 認證流程：準備文件 / 樣品 / 電路圖 / 天線規格、提交 [[RCB]] 核驗機構初審、[[TAF]] 認可實驗室 RF / EMC 測試約 3–4 週、報告審查與證書核發，並稱證書有效期 5 年。
- 來源列出台灣領先認證實驗室：[[耕興]]、[[SGS]]、[[電信技術中心]] / [[ISL]]。
- 來源稱[[耕興]]具 30 MHz–325 GHz 全頻段測試能力、108 座測試場地、連續 10 年 FCC 最佳實驗室認證、10 米半電波暗室、OTA / SAR / [[相控陣列天線]]測試等能力。
- 來源簡述 [[FCC 無線設備法規測試]]、[[CE RED 無線設備法規測試]]、Wi‑Fi / BLE 聯盟流程的差異。
- 來源將 LEO 衛星終端認證應用連到 Starlink / Kuiper user terminal RF validation、[[相控陣列天線]] beamforming 測試、mmWave / MIMO 高頻測試、台灣供應鏈 GMA，以及耕興等 [[RCB]] 提供 8–12 週 GMA 週期的說法。

R&S FSWX › 產品定位與架構
- 產品定位：multiport signal and spectrum analyzer。
- 內部 multipath architecture 支援 1-port 與 2-port instruments。
- 可用於 spectrum、noise measurement、phase noise、modulation quality（EVM）的 [[Cross-correlation]]。
- 提供 extended [[Spurious free dynamic range]]（SFDR）。
- 改善 [[Displayed average noise level]]（DANL）以尋找 hidden spurs。
- 可在 high-power carrier 存在時量測 distortion 與 noise。
- 可針對 EVM 要求嚴苛的 components 做 characterization。
- Multipath wideband phase coherent receivers 可使用 independent receivers 同時進行 signal analysis 與 spectrum analysis。
- 可在 spectrum 任意位置、相同或不同頻率同時觀察 signals。
- 可同時量測 antenna 的 H 或 V polarizations、device input 與 output，並直接比較 ports 之間的 amplitude、frequency、phase。
- Image free I/Q and vector signal analysis 使用 preselected capture and analysis，避免 unwanted signals 干擾量測。
- Operating system：Linux based operating system，目標為 high security 與 long-term support。

規格定義：

- Specifications with limits：以範圍或限制值表示 warranted product performance，使用 `<, ≤, >, ≥, ±, maximum, minimum` 等標示。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits (`n. trc.`)：依 specifications with limits 測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的量測設備，Rohde & Schwarz 不保證。
- Specifications without limits：代表 warranted product performance，通常為尺寸或設定解析度等無或可忽略偏差的值。
- Typical data (`typ.`)：代表約 `80%` 量產儀器可達到的性能，或代表平均值。
- Nominal values (`nom.`)：代表性數值，不做 statistical evaluation，生產時不測試。
- Measured values (`meas.`)：來自個別樣品的 measurement results。
- Uncertainties：coverage factor = `2`，依 GUM 規則計算，考慮 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。

Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology › 重點摘要
- 來源將 wireless products 的 market access approval testing 分成三類：[[Regulatory Compliance Test]]、[[Telecom Industry Certification Test]]、[[Cellular Network Operator Acceptance Test]]。Regulatory compliance 被描述為各區域法律面 market access 的必要條件；industry certification 例子包含 [[GCF]] / Cellular、[[Bluetooth SIG]]、[[FiRa]] / [[UWB]]、[[Wi-Fi Alliance]]；operator acceptance test 例子包含 AT&T、VzW、T-mobile、CMCC。
- 來源主張 wireless products 需要 [[CE marking]] / [[FCC ID]]；test results 是 technical documentation 的一部分，需在產品投放市場前準備、可提供給 surveillance authorities，並自 placed on the market 起保存 10 years。
- 來源列出 Ericsson Mobility Visualizer Jan 2023 的 mobile subscriptions 表，顯示 2022–2028 的 5G subscriptions 由 1046.006 增至 4974.568；但單位與表格數值口徑未在轉檔文字中完整標示。
- [[CE RED 無線設備法規測試]]被整理成四類 essential requirements：Art 3.1a Health & Safety、Art 3.1b EMC、Art 3.2 Radio Spectrum、Art 3.3 Specific topics。來源列出多個 ETSI EN standards，例如 [[EN 300 328]]、[[EN 301 893]]、[[EN 303 687]]、[[EN 301 908-1]]、[[EN 301 908-13]]、[[EN 301 908-24]]、[[EN 301 908-25]]、[[EN 301 489-52]] 等。
- 對 [[5G NR SAR testing]]，來源指出 5G NR network emulator is required to drive EUT to extreme transmission condition，multi-radio UE 的 average-SAR feature 需要 flexible signaling functions，涵蓋 cellular standards、Wi-Fi 與 Bluetooth；來源將 [[R&S CMW500]] / [[R&S CMX500]] 稱為 SAR / HAC signaling solution。
- 對 Art 3.1b EMC，來源指出 EMC tests 需要 radio enabled 與 radio disabled conditions，因此 5G NR 也需要 signaling solution；mobile phone 仍需要 [[Audio Breakthrough]] test，從 GSM 到 VoLTE / VoNR by 5G。來源提到 [[R&S TS9982 EMS Test System]] 與 [[R&S TS9975 EMI Test System]]。
- 對 Art 3.2 Radio Spectrum，來源指出 5G NR specification 包含 FR1 與 FR2；FR1 test setup stays conducted，FR2 test setup becomes radiated；並把 3GPP test cases、CTIA-OTA test cases、TRP / TRS、RSE 測試連到 [[R&S TS8991]] 與 [[R&S TS8996]]。

The passages do not rank the “most important” capabilities, but they do support these key Signal Integrity–related capabilities for Wireless Communication applications: interface testing with scopes, BERTs, AWGs and switch matrices; RefClk / PLL jitter performance testing with phase noise analyzers and signal generators; PDN testing with scopes and network analyzers; ADC / DAC frontend performance testing with spectrum analyzers and signal generators; and PCB/PCBA SI flow items including insertion loss, crosstalk, eye diagram, TDR impedance, stackup planning and transmission-line calculation [1][2].  
For wireless device and certification contexts, relevant capabilities also include RF testing, EMC, spectrum, output power, DFS, SAR, EMI / EMS, ESD, power surge, protocol compatibility, interoperability, PTCRB / GCF certification, TRP, TIS and EVM measurement [7][11][70].  
For mmWave / 5G FR2 wireless applications, supported capabilities include CATR chamber measurement, 3–40 GHz main transmit band support, unwanted-emission measurement to 90 GHz, TRP / TIS / EVM measurement, FR2 radiated test setups, and short-cable remote-radio-head architectures to optimize radiated chamber link budget [7][23][38].  
For OTA and MIMO wireless performance, supported capabilities include antenna and radio performance validation in realistic indoor / urban multipath RF environments, Wi‑Fi 7 / IEEE 802.11be MIMO stress testing under realistic conditions, SISO / MIMO OTA support, carrier aggregation across many channels and bands, and Wi‑Fi / Bluetooth / Narrowband NTN / RedCap support in integrated OTA solutions [34][35][41][42][44].  
For signal and spectrum analysis, supported capabilities include phase noise, modulation quality / EVM, cross-correlation, extended SFDR, improved DANL for hidden spurs, distortion and noise measurement in the presence of high-power carriers, phase-coherent multiport receiver analysis, simultaneous signal and spectrum analysis, antenna H/V polarization comparison, and direct comparison of amplitude, frequency and phase between ports [13].

Rohde & Schwarz and ETS-Lindgren partner to offer OTA testing solutions for next-gen wireless technologies › 重點摘要
- [[ETS-Lindgren]] 已將 [[R&S CMX500]] one-box signaling tester 與 [[R&S SMBV100B]] vector signal generator 整合到 [[EMQuest]] software。
- 來源稱此 collaboration 支援 latest standards，包括 [[5G FR1]]、[[5G FR2]]、[[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[A-GNSS]]。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 被描述為支援 cellular and non-cellular technologies，包括 [[4G LTE]]、[[5G NR]] [[5G FR1]]、[[5G FR2]]、latest [[5G RedCap]] 與 [[Wi-Fi]] up to latest [[Wi-Fi 7]] standard。
- [[R&S SMBV100B]] 被描述為 vector signal generator，具 ultra-high output power、fully calibrated wideband signal generation，且是 full featured [[GNSS constellation simulator]]。
- 來源說 [[R&S SMBV100B]] 與 [[R&S CMX500]] combination 可在 controlled conditions 下執行 realistic and repeatable [[A-GNSS]] scenarios。
- 將 Rohde & Schwarz instruments 與 [[ETS-Lindgren]] anechoic chambers / [[EMQuest]] software 整合後，來源稱可形成 powerful turnkey solutions，使 customers keep pace with latest wireless technology advancements。
- Integrated solutions 被描述為 [[CTIA]] certified for [[4G]] and [[5G FR1]]，並支援 [[SISO]] 與 [[MIMO]]。
- 來源稱 4G and 5G carrier combinations 可使用 carrier aggregation across hundreds of channels and bands。
- Additional technologies：[[Wi-Fi]] up to version 7、[[Bluetooth]]、[[Narrowband NTN]] 與 [[RedCap]]，來源稱 fully supported using Rohde & Schwarz instrumentation and [[EMQuest]] software。
- 引言人物：來源列 [[Christoph Pointer]] 為 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] Senior Vice President of Mobile Radio Tester；但既有相近 PR 來源列名為 [[Christoph Pointner]]。此為未決拼寫 / 職稱差異。

- Press & media contact：[[Christian Mokry]]，PR Manager Test & measurement，email 為 press@rohde-schwarz.com。

Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology › 重點摘要
- 來源將 wireless products 的 market access approval testing 分成三類：[[Regulatory Compliance Test]]、[[Telecom Industry Certification Test]]、[[Cellular Network Operator Acceptance Test]]。Regulatory compliance 被描述為各區域法律面 market access 的必要條件；industry certification 例子包含 [[GCF]] / Cellular、[[Bluetooth SIG]]、[[FiRa]] / [[UWB]]、[[Wi-Fi Alliance]]；operator acceptance test 例子包含 AT&T、VzW、T-mobile、CMCC。
- 來源主張 wireless products 需要 [[CE marking]] / [[FCC ID]]；test results 是 technical documentation 的一部分，需在產品投放市場前準備、可提供給 surveillance authorities，並自 placed on the market 起保存 10 years。
- 來源列出 Ericsson Mobility Visualizer Jan 2023 的 mobile subscriptions 表，顯示 2022–2028 的 5G subscriptions 由 1046.006 增至 4974.568；但單位與表格數值口徑未在轉檔文字中完整標示。
- [[CE RED 無線設備法規測試]]被整理成四類 essential requirements：Art 3.1a Health & Safety、Art 3.1b EMC、Art 3.2 Radio Spectrum、Art 3.3 Specific topics。來源列出多個 ETSI EN standards，例如 [[EN 300 328]]、[[EN 301 893]]、[[EN 303 687]]、[[EN 301 908-1]]、[[EN 301 908-13]]、[[EN 301 908-24]]、[[EN 301 908-25]]、[[EN 301 489-52]] 等。
- 對 [[5G NR SAR testing]]，來源指出 5G NR network emulator is required to drive EUT to extreme transmission condition，multi-radio UE 的 average-SAR feature 需要 flexible signaling functions，涵蓋 cellular standards、Wi-Fi 與 Bluetooth；來源將 [[R&S CMW500]] / [[R&S CMX500]] 稱為 SAR / HAC signaling solution。
- 對 Art 3.1b EMC，來源指出 EMC tests 需要 radio enabled 與 radio disabled conditions，因此 5G NR 也需要 signaling solution；mobile phone 仍需要 [[Audio Breakthrough]] test，從 GSM 到 VoLTE / VoNR by 5G。來源提到 [[R&S TS9982 EMS Test System]] 與 [[R&S TS9975 EMI Test System]]。
- 對 Art 3.2 Radio Spectrum，來源指出 5G NR specification 包含 FR1 與 FR2；FR1 test setup stays conducted，FR2 test setup becomes radiated；並把 3GPP test cases、CTIA-OTA test cases、TRP / TRS、RSE 測試連到 [[R&S TS8991]] 與 [[R&S TS8996]]。

4G 5G NR WLAN OTA MIMO stress testing › 與 reverberation chamber OTA testing 的關係
[[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]] 說 [[Bluetest]] RTS reverberation chambers simulate realistic indoor and urban environments。這與 [[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]] 對 [[Reverberation chamber OTA testing]] 的說明相連：reverberation chambers 透過 RF signal 多重反射形成 [[Rayleigh faded multipath RF environment]]，用於接近 real-world indoor and city conditions 的 OTA 測試。

Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices › 重點摘要
- [[Bluetest]] 與 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 擴展既有合作，將 [[R&S CMX500]] one-box signaling tester 的 [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality 整合到 [[Bluetest Flow]] control software。
- 整合後，next-generation WLAN technology 的 developers 與 manufacturers 可使用 [[Bluetest]] reverberation test systems（RTS）對 [[IEEE 802.11be]] stations 與 access points 在 realistic conditions 下進行 MIMO stress testing。
- 來源以 [[Bluetest RTS65]] 為例，說明 [[Bluetest]] reverberation chambers 用於 wireless devices 的 over-the-air performance evaluation。
- 來源說明 reverberation chamber 與 anechoic test chamber 的差異：reverberation chamber 會在 chamber 內大量反射 RF signal，形成 Rayleigh faded multipath RF environment；此環境接近 real-world indoor and city conditions。
- [[Bluetest Flow]] 被描述為 complex wireless solutions 的 integrated test environment。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 被描述為 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester，具 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality、multiple radio technologies support 與 embedded IP test capabilities。
- [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]] 的 key components 被列為 320 MHz channel bandwidth、up to 16 spatial streams、4096 QAM modulation 與 [[MLO]]。
- 來源指出 [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature；因此測試環境提供 multiple RF chains 很關鍵。
- Rohde & Schwarz 引言人物為 [[Christoph Pointner]]，職稱 Senior Vice President of Mobile Radio Testers at Rohde & Schwarz。
- Bluetest 引言人物為 [[Kjell Olovsson]]，職稱 Bluetest CEO。
- Press & media contact 為 [[Christian Mokry]]，PR Manager Test & measurement，email 為 press@rohde-schwarz.com。
- Rohde & Schwarz 公司資訊：2024/2025 fiscal year（July to June）net revenue EUR 3.16 billion；2025-06-30 員工超過 15,000 人。
- Bluetest 公司資訊：[[Bluetest AB]] based in Gothenburg, Sweden；來源稱其為 wireless equipment and small antenna OTA testing using Reverberation Test System 的 pioneer and market leader。

依 [[無線通訊認證實驗室]]：

- 主要測試項目包含：頻譜、輸出功率、[[DFS]]、[[SAR]]、EMI / EMS、靜電放電、電源突波、[[Protocol 相容性]]、互操作性測試、[[PTCRB]] / [[GCF]] 認證。
- 認證必要性包含防止電磁干擾與頻譜衝突、保障用戶安全、加速上市、降低召回與法律風險，以及滿足台灣供應鏈衛星終端、6G 等需求。
